title: fix(pages): report the actual page size after resize_page (#2998)

target.summary: Querying `Page.getLayoutMetrics` returns stale viewport dimensions when the page is in a background tab because Chrome defers layout until the tab becomes visible. As a result, `resize_page` reports incorrect old dimensions for background tabs even though the window resize succeeded.
notes: faulty call to Page.getLayoutMetrics which returns stale layout data for background tabs
definition of the method whose behavior is wrong
call site that relies on the faulty returned dimensions to report clamped page size
